description: OW-07 orphan ratchet exceptions (scripts/check_orphans.ts). Each entry is a reviewed, intentional exception with the reason it is kept (wave-3 triage, ORPHAN_DECISIONS_2026-10-01.md); placeholder 'backlog' reasons are rejected. New orphans fail the check, and an entry that stops being an orphan must be removed. Actuator ops advertised in actuator-op-discovery.json and named by a unit test, and ops the provider bridge resolves to a cli_native harness capability, are reachable by rule and never listed here.

libs_core_modules.reason: Side-effect bootstrap behind the public subpath @agent/core/acp-mediator (libs/core/package.json exports): imports risky-op-registry so a package-name consumer gets the governed approval handler, then re-exports acp-mediator. Consumed by package name only; no in-repo consumer yet (ACP mediator work).
